Hamburg · Models Agency

MIRRRS
Models.

Mirrrs Models is a new-generation agency built on care, integrity, and long-term vision. Founded 11 years ago, Mirrrs has grown into a platform that prioritizes authenticity, individuality, and sustainable development within the industry.

We believe that while looks may evolve, charisma endures. Our focus is on discovering raw talent and developing it with intention — creating careers that extend far beyond fleeting moments.

At Mirrrs, we approach talent management with honesty and responsibility. We value confidence, character, and a strong sense of self, supporting each talent in a way that feels grounded and real. Because true presence cannot be manufactured — it is nurtured over time.

In an industry often driven by speed and pressure, we choose a different pace. We believe that when talent is supported with respect, trust, and clear direction, success follows naturally.

Mirrrs stands for a more conscious way of working — where professionalism meets humanity, and where careers are built to last.

    Hamburg · Founded 2015

    Ali
    Garcia.
    MIRRRS.

    "Still here, still passionate, still ready for what's next. I entered this industry as a model booker — and never looked back."

    Founded 2015
    Experience 20 years
    Based in Hamburg
    Director Ali Garcia
    01

    What inspired you to start your own modeling agency?

    To be honest, it was my strong desire to simply have some peace — to step away from the constant obligation of having to be in an office at 9 a.m., and from the never-ending discussions about how a scout or agent works completely differently than a 9-to-6 booker — and has to work differently. I needed space to feel inspired again. And that's what I ultimately chose. The final decision came to me overnight — in May 2015.

    02

    Was there a defining moment when you knew this was the path?

    At the time, I never gave much thought to what MIRRRS could eventually become. I wasn't even aware that things like a domain or the technical infrastructure behind it were necessary. My focus was purely on scouting new faces, handling parts of model booking — guided by a genuine passion, an open heart, and the instinct that comes with it.

    03

    Where were you in life when you decided to begin?

    I wanted to move to New York City to work for an agency and to have a complete change of scenery — to try something entirely new. But something inside me didn't feel right. So, almost overnight, I threw all my plans overboard and decided to start this heartfelt project called MIRRRS Models — with only a vague sense of what could happen or what it might become.

    04

    The secret behind the name MIRRRS.

    The story behind the name MIRRRS — it's probably the question I've been asked most over the past ten years. And the truth? There is no story. The name has no real meaning, and it never will.

    Back then, I urgently needed a domain — I had less than 24 hours to go live. My neighbors at the time were web designers. We sat around talking, and suddenly they were throwing out ideas like purring cats and mirrors. It was completely absurd — but also strangely memorable. Twelve hours before launch, I just said: 'Screw it, let's go with MIRRRS. I'll change it in a few months anyway.' I never did. And I never will.

    Because in the end, the name never really mattered to me. My focus was always — and still is — on the model. On the person. On the energy. Not on perfect branding, not on finding the ideal name, not on the logo. That's never been my thing. And it still isn't.

    MIRRRS is MIRRRS. I love what I do — and even after all these years, I still get genuinely excited every time I see a great new polaroid or test image.

    "Thank you to all — my family, my mentors, supporters, partners, and clients who've been part of the journey."

    Ali Garcia — Director & Founder, MIRRRS Models
